name: Nuage DB
description: Nuage DB, Memoire's own database in Rust: everything encrypted at rest, several applications with a database each, tables on disk behind a write-ahead log, instant branches, backups restored at boot, a console at /admin and a live dashboard at /app.

NUAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: The key everything is encrypted with (pages, log, backups). Keep a copy: without it the data and its backups cannot be read.

NUAGE_TOKEN.description: Token of the first application (clients send it as a bearer token). The console at /admin makes more applications, each with its own database and tokens.

NUAGE_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password of the console at /admin (it also opens the live dashboard at /app).

NUAGE_ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Token of the management API (/api/apps, `nuage apps create <name>`): it creates applications and their tokens in one request.

NUAGE_PUBLIC_STATUS.description: true: /api/status and /app show a public subset (status, uptime, services) without signing in.

NUAGE_BACKUP_S3_BUCKET.description: Bucket for the backups. The dyno's disk is erased at each restart: the data is restored from here at boot.

NUAGE_BACKUP_S3_ENDPOINT.description: Endpoint URL of S3-compatible storage (leave empty for AWS).

NUAGE_BACKUP2_S3_BUCKET.description: Optional: a second bucket for the backups, kept in step with the first; a boot restores from the one that reaches furthest. To move the backups without a stop: set it, wait until /admin shows each backup with no error, then remove the NUAGE_BACKUP_S3_* variables.

NUAGE_BACKUP2_S3_REGION.description: Region of the second bucket (us-east-1 when empty).

NUAGE_BACKUP2_S3_ENDPOINT.description: Endpoint URL of the second bucket's storage (leave empty for AWS).

NUAGE_BACKUP2_S3_PREFIX.description: Prefix of the backup objects in the second bucket (nuage/ when empty).

NUAGE_BACKUP2_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Access key of the second bucket.

NUAGE_BACKUP2_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Secret key of the second bucket.

NUAGE_RESTORE_REQUIRED.description: Leave empty on a first deployment, which has nothing to restore. Once the server holds data, set it to true: a dyno that finds nothing to restore (a mistyped bucket or prefix) then refuses to start, instead of starting a new, empty database.

NUAGE_KV_STORAGE.description: Where the key-value stores (/v1/kv) are kept: memory (empty: the fastest, emptied at each restart) or database (in each application's database: kept across restarts and in the backups; a write waits for the disk).

SITE_URL.description: Public address of the website (canonical links, share card), e.g. https://my-nuage.herokuapp.com. Empty: taken from each request.
